goals: Make Frost Protection I or higher on any single equipped armor slot grant the player leather-boots-equivalent immunity to powdered-snow traversal effects.
Change the Blessing of Demeter crafted book, without changing its existing recipe, to contain only Frost Protection III by removing the existing Frost Walker II and Frost Protection II enchantments.

Preserve Frost Protection behavior outside the requested powdered-snow traversal change and preserve unrelated Matcha Flavoured content unless implementation investigation establishes a necessary compatibility adjustment.
scope: Pin the exact Matcha Flavoured 1.12 Frost Protection, freezing-water, and Blessing of Demeter contracts plus vanilla Minecraft 26.2's leather-boots powdered-snow traversal seam.
Extend only vanilla's powdered-snow walkability decision so Frost Protection I or higher on the helmet, chestplate, leggings, or boots is sufficient for the targeted traversal behavior.

Replace only the enchantments produced by the resolved Blessing of Demeter recipe so its resulting book contains exactly Frost Protection III, with the existing Frost Walker II and Frost Protection II enchantments absent and no unintended additional enchantments.
Verify representative client, save/reload, and multiplayer or dedicated-server behavior during Canary 1 runtime acceptance when relevant.

exclusions: Changes to Matcha's Frost Protection supported-items contract; normal acquisition remains limited to chest armor even though traversal recognizes the enchantment when directly present on any armor slot.
Replacement of Matcha Flavoured's enchantment system or broad changes beyond the narrow behavior and result edits in this project.
Global changes to Frost Walker or changes to ordinary Frost Walker behavior.
Changes to the Blessing of Demeter recipe ingredients, recipe shape, or crafting method.
Changes to unrelated Matcha Flavoured enchantments, recipes, items, mechanics, projects, or resource packs.
Changes to Frost Protection's existing behavior outside the requested powdered-snow traversal behavior unless implementation evidence demonstrates that a compatibility adjustment is necessary.
Modification of originals or either Minecraft instance, runtime-slot mutation, deployment, or inferred runtime validation during Canary 1 implementation.

dependencies.reason: Exact target game version whose powdered-snow and enchantment behavior Canary 1 preserves and extends narrowly.
Fabric runtime loader minimum declared by Canary 1.
Exact pinned Frost Protection enchantment, freezing-water function, and Blessing of Demeter recipe contracts extended by Canary 1.
Required Java release for Minecraft 26.2 and the Canary 1 build.
Exact build-tool version used for the retained Canary 1 artifact.

state.milestone: Canary 1 implementation is complete, statically verified, retained, and ready for controlled runtime testing, but its project UUID occupies neither test slot, so it remains ACTIVE, not deployed, and Minecraft runtime untested.
